news.Title: 二次暴倉在即？7月剛被強平 9月又押錯方向　華爾街「AI股神」再陷倉位危機
news.Content:
曾被華爾街捧為「AI股神」的25歲避險基金經理Leopold Aschenbrenner，旗下基金Situational Awareness今年7月遭遇強平危機後，9月初重建的AI股多頭倉位近期再度承压，市場關注其看漲選擇權部位是否面臨權利金歸零風險。

Aschenbrenner曾任OpenAI「超級對齊」團隊研究員，2024年發表165頁長文《Situational Awareness》預言AI算力將吞噬晶片、記憶體與電力，隨後在舊金山成立同名基金，獲矽谷與華爾街資金追捧。其策略始終明確，重押閃迪與美光等記憶體股，押注大模型訓練帶動HBM與企業級NAND需求。

上述策略在今年上半年大賺，基金年內報酬率一度達439%，資產規模衝上450億美元，但轉折發生在今年7月下旬。美股AI硬體族群出現約兩成技術性回檔，在約4倍融資槓桿下，股價跌兩成即意味本金清零，摩根大通等重量級經紀商發出追加保證金通知並收緊信貸額度，基金被迫低價拋售持倉。

13F文件顯示，截至6月底基金美股多頭約202億美元，其中持有閃迪約57億、美光約56億，兩股合佔逾半數，強平數日內基金淨值回撤約67%，大批核心部位以約五成折讓轉讓給城堡證券(Citadel)。諷刺的是，8月相關硬體股強勁反彈，他卻已出局。

在7月致歉信中，Aschenbrenner承諾移除槓桿、改以自有資金或全額支付期權操作。上月初，Aschenbrenner轉與經紀商Clear Street合作，投入數億美元權利金買入超微、英特爾、SK海力士、SanDisk、CoreWeave等看漲選擇權，最大虧損鎖定在權利金內，券商無法盤中強平。

但選擇權引入「時間」變數。自9月建倉以來，七檔核心標的平均回跌18.3%，CoreWeave跌逾三分之一，SK海力士與閃迪跌約四分之一，現貨持有者能「躺平」等解套，選擇權卻因遠離履約價、時間價值流失而迅速萎縮；若到期前未大漲，權利金將歸零。

市場分析指出，Situational Awareness的兩次危機並非產業判斷錯誤，而是二級市場博弈邏輯不同。當基金槓桿、持倉與到期結構暴露在明處，倉位本身會成為對手盤打壓流動性的依據。數學與程式面對的是規則固定的世界，盤面價格卻是資金期限與人性博弈的結果。

隨著下月中第三季13F持倉報告即將發布，市場將確認這批選擇權真實規模。無論數字為何，Aschenbrenner三個內二度「高台跳水」已成一則樣本：數據能推演產業遠方，但價格從來只反映當下人心。

news.Title: AI燒錢過猛引爆市場疑慮　美股遇數月來最慘賣壓
news.Content:
（中央社紐約2026年10月22日綜合外電報導）受科技巨頭財報引發資本支出擔憂，加上中東局勢再度升溫，美股22日遭遇數月以來最慘烈的一波拋售潮。避險資金湧入美債，帶動美債殖利率創下逾一年來最大單日跌幅。

紐約時報指出，標普500（S&P 500）指數下跌1.2%，創7月以來最大單日跌幅；科技股比重較高的那斯達克（Nasdaq）指數則重挫2.6%，創6月以來最大單日跌幅。

投資人對科技巨頭大舉投入資金、擴張人工智慧（AI）業務的做法愈發憂慮。這些鉅額支出不僅吃掉企業現金，也迫使業者大量舉債。

科技巨擘Meta股價今天暴跌7%。Meta前一天公布財報，顯示自由現金流大幅減少，並表示將發行新類別股票，以籌措更多資金，投入資料中心及其他AI計畫。

同樣公布本季計劃再投入數百億美元擴張AI業務的SpaceX，股價也下跌逾9%。

出於對AI支出的疑慮日益升高，嚇壞的投資人轉向美國公債，尋求相對安全的資產，推動公債殖利率出現一年多來其中一個最劇烈的單日跌幅。美國10年期公債殖利率跌破5%，30年期公債殖利率則降至5.3%。

資金大舉撤出風險資產、湧向避險標的，帶動美債價格強勁反彈，殖利率創下一年多來罕見最大單日跌幅的走勢，與過去數月殖利率持續攀升的情況形成反差。

即便輝達（Nvidia）和博通（Broadcom）等原本可望受惠於科技業承諾加碼興建資料中心、採購更多晶片的晶片公司，股價也未能倖免，同樣下跌。

分析師阿邁德．汗（Malik Ahmed Khan）說：「投資人如今對整個AI生態系的健康狀況，都打上了一個大大的問號。」

英國「金融時報」指出，Meta股價重挫7%，市值蒸發約1240億美元；Meta預測未來幾年可能需要籌措「數千億美元」，以支應其押注AI的投資計畫。

巴克萊銀行（Barclays）美國通膨策略主管希爾（Jon Hill）說：「今天美國公債市場的漲勢，並非受近期任何基本面數據影響，完全是源於市場對AI行情動搖的恐慌反應。」

Meta於21日的申報文件指出，由於Alphabet等競爭對手紛紛進行大規模發債，加上Anthropic、OpenAI等新創AI巨頭在SpaceX上市後也醞釀龐大的IPO計畫，市場融資環境正面臨日趨嚴峻的挑戰。

今年以來晶片股一直是表現最突出的類股之一，投資人看好支撐AI熱潮的硬體需求將大幅成長，如今這些股票也遭到拋售。費城半導體指數重挫近7%，一名交易員指出，先前漲勢凌厲的熱門股票正面臨沉重賣壓。

美國科技股自10月初創下歷史新高以來，已歷經數波劇烈震盪。投資人擔心，AI概念股股價大幅飆升，加上企業為興建資料中心、採購晶片而大舉發債，相關投資是否已過度擴張。

投資機構Academy Securities宏觀策略主管契爾（Peter Tchir）說：「問題其實都回到AI敘事的各面向。市場究竟能否消化所有AI支出？」

news.Title: 好在有颱風？台股多休2天能躲股災？分析師：可緩衝但補跌難免
news.Content:
受到市場對 AI 資本支出疑慮與中東局勢升溫影響，美股費半暴跌逾6%，台積電 ADR 大跌 4.52%，但適逢薔琵颱風襲台，北北基桃今（23）日停班停課，台股同步休市一日，意外避開美股血洗的第一波衝擊，引發網友熱議笑稱是「護國神風」。面對今日休市加上周一光復節補假，資深分析師蔡明翰表示，颱風假與連假確實提供了「時間緩衝」，但關鍵仍需看連假期間美股能否止跌回升、開低走高，否則台股開盤後的修正與補跌依然在所難免。

颱風休市引熱議 網友幾家歡喜幾家愁

周四美股四大指數漲跌互現。道瓊工業指數微漲 11.89 點（0.02%）；那斯達克指數則重挫2.6%，創6月初以來最大單日跌幅；費城半導體指數更暴跌6.72%，其中，台積電ADR挫4.52%。

適逢薔琵颱風襲台，北北基桃宣布今日停止上班上課，台北股市、期貨及台北外匯市場同步休市一日。台股因颱風假意外避開美股暴跌的第一波衝擊，迅速在PTT等各大論壇引發熱烈討論。

不少網友慶幸直呼：「好在台股休市」、「颱風救了台股」；但也有理性與悲觀的投資人提醒，休市只是將開盤時間延後，市場累積的跌幅終究需要面對，紛紛擔心開盤會面臨補跌壓力。

休市能避開股災？ 分析師：能緩衝，但修正難免

針對美股重挫，台股今日因颱風假休市，加上周一光復節補假，等於獲得長達四天的休市緩衝，究竟能否順利避開股災？資深台股分析師蔡明翰指出，颱風假與連假確實提供了「時間緩衝」，但關鍵在於這幾天休市期間美股能否止跌回升、開低走高，否則台股開盤後的修正與補跌依然在所難免。

蔡明翰說明，當前市場格局幾乎是在複製今年7月與2024年4月的修正架構。科技股在經歷先前大漲後，正好面臨美股財報季的嚴峻考驗。目前市場氛圍偏向悲觀，焦點全放在雲端服務大廠（CSP）龐大的AI資本支出「到底能不能賺回來、未來還能不能接到訂單」，導致市場將資本支出增加解讀為利空，進而拖累整體股市修正。

翻轉訊號何時出現？ 關鍵是下周科技巨頭財報

對於大盤何時能真正扭轉頹勢，蔡明翰表示，根據歷史經驗，市場要從悲觀轉為正向，必須等待科技巨頭的財報重磅登場。在修正過程中，當企業宣布提高資本支出、市場反應卻「利空不跌、不爆反漲」時，才代表整體觀望風暴正式告一段落。

隨著Meta財報落幕，市場緊接著將焦點轉向下週公布財報的微軟（Microsoft）、Google（Alphabet）與亞馬遜（Amazon）。蔡明翰預期，在台股連假結束前，美股週五與週一有機會出現跌深反彈，這將有助於減緩台股開盤後的下殺壓力；不過在科技巨頭釋出明確利多訊號前，短線反彈後仍有賣壓，投資人宜審慎觀察後續財報表現與市場情緒轉變。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 薔琵成護盤關鍵？費半重挫6.7%、亞股一片綠！眾人鬆口氣：台股躲過一劫
news.Content:
中颱薔琵今（23）日襲台，全台21縣市宣布停班停課，由於昨（22）日費城半導體指數重挫逾700點，加上台股夜盤一度大跌500多點，亞股同樣也綠油油，不少投資人捏了一把冷汗，直呼「還好放颱風假」。有網友發文指出，要是今天照常開盤，恐怕又有一堆人哀嚎、嚇得臉色發青，颱風假等於替股市躲過一劫，貼文曝光後，掀起股民熱議。

費半、亞股重挫！眾人：台股放颱風假躲過一劫

一名網友在社群平台《Threads》發文表示，美股大跌六、七百點、夜盤也下挫500點，幸好颱風來襲、股市休市，否則今天又要哀鴻遍野，這場颱風假連同週末共休四天，下一場開盤要等到週二，可說是暫時逃過一劫；另一名網友則說，原本以為今天台股要血流成河，沒想到颱風一來就「暫停行刑」，昨晚費半暴跌6.7%、AI股被重擊，台股卻能直接休四天，不禁好奇週二開盤究竟是「開盤」還是「開獎」。

貼文曝光後，網友紛紛表示，「颱風假是今年最成功的護盤」，也有人認為「看今天及下週一美股、日韓股市表現，該來的躲不過」；另有網友直言「除非油價下跌，不然週二開盤還是要補跌」，還有人感嘆「連假這麼多次，每次放假前都大漲、快收假又下跌，台股只能跟著跌，來一次連假大跌、收假大漲，台股跟漲也不為過吧」，更有人喊出「躲過一劫」、「繼續殺融資」。

回頭來看國際盤勢，市場對AI相關企業資本支出的擔憂升溫，加上中東情勢緊張、油價走揚，週四美股漲跌互見：道瓊工業指數上漲11.89點、漲幅0.02%，收52867.98點；標普500指數下跌93.74點、跌幅1.21%，收7663.43點；那斯達克綜合指數下跌694點、跌幅2.6%，收26008.86點；費城半導體指數下跌773.58點、跌幅6.72%，收10731.98點。

亞股方面，截至10

news.Title: 外資千億爆砍後接「4天空窗期」...台股玩完了？野村曬數據搖頭：還有戲
news.Content:
美國CPI高於市場預期，升息疑慮再升，台股日前遭外資單日賣超高達3,025.55億元，刷新歷史紀錄。隨著光復節連假加上加上薔琵颱風，市場面臨4天空窗期。不過，外資大舉賣超是否意味台股後市轉弱？野村投信表示，回顧歷史上外資單日大幅賣超後的市場表現，短期雖受到資金撤離與市場情緒影響，但過去外資前十大賣超20個交易日後，均開始呈現正報酬，120交易日後加權指數平均總報酬更達26.7%。

野村投信統計，回顧外資單日賣超金額前十大事件，觀察後續20、60及120個交易日，台股加權指數平均總報酬分別為2.19%、19%及26.7%，呈現隨時間拉長逐步回升的趨勢。

進一步觀察大型權值股，FTSE臺灣50指數同期平均總報酬分別為2.44%、20.63%及28.98%，均優於加權指數。

若進一步聚焦創新科技，TIP臺灣創新科技50指數表現更為突出，三個期間平均總報酬分別達3.68%、32.44%及40.36%，其中120個交易日平均表現較加權指數高出13.66個百分點。顯示歷史上外資大幅調節後，具備產業競爭優勢的科技市值型企業，在市場情緒回穩後有機會展現較強的成長動能。

野村臺灣新科技50 ETF（00935）基金經理人林怡君指出，近期台股受到利率高檔、AI融資成本攀升及部分AI伺服器訂單遞延等因素影響，短線波動加劇，但AI基礎建設的長期投資趨勢仍未改變。

大型雲端服務供應商持續擴大資本支出，隨著新一代Vera Rubin平台預期於第四季末至明年第一季初逐步放量，加上客製化晶片（ASIC）出貨成長，相關供應鏈明年第一季有望呈現淡季不淡。

野村投信內部台股股票池預估2027年每股盈餘（EPS）成長約29%，顯示企業獲利仍具支撐。不過，在資金成本上升與產業競爭加劇下，供應鏈表現可能進一步分化，具備關鍵技術、穩定接單能力及良好獲利品質的一線企業，較有機會維持競爭優勢。

林怡君進一步指出，隨著AI應用由模型訓練延伸至推論，產業成長機會逐漸擴散至先進封裝、電子零組件、高速傳輸及散熱等領域，科技股布局不能只看企業規模，更應重視研發投入與技術競爭力。

許如鎧／財經特派記者，主跑經濟部、電子電信、能源等

news.Title: 颱風假變崩盤假？夜盤狂殺近600點 專家：下周二開盤「算總帳」緊盯2件事
news.Content:
Meta財報重燃華爾街對人工智慧（AI）龐大資本支出的投資回報疑慮，引發美股周四（22日）科技股拋售潮。費城半導體指數狂瀉6.72%，台積電ADR也重挫4.52%，拖累台指期夜盤終場大跌580點，收在45654點，失守46000點大關。專家指出，這次崩跌比較像殺本益比，不像金融體系出事；由於台股連同颱風假有四天連假休市，下周二開盤前要把美股三個交易日的帳算完，投資人應緊盯周一費半收在哪，以及油價漲了多少。

美股七巨頭與晶片股全線重挫

Facebook母公司Meta第3季營收雖優於預期，但上調全年資本支出預估，且自由現金流罕見轉負，為公司IPO以來首見。此外，Meta的5年期信用違約交換（CDS）利差創歷史新高，凸顯市場對其信用風險的疑慮增加。

受此影響，美股四大指數跌多漲少，道瓊工業指數小漲0.02%，收52,867.98點；標普500指數下跌1.21%，收7,663.43點；那斯達克指數重挫2.60%，收26,008.86點；費半指數狂跌6.72%，收10,731.98點。

美股七巨頭幾乎全數失守，輝達大跌4.4%，Meta重挫6.98%，Alphabet、微軟與特斯拉均下跌2%至3%不等，僅蘋果逆勢上漲1.23%。記憶體與台股ADR同樣淪為重災區，SK海力士ADR慘跌8.07%，美光、威騰電子與希捷科技跌幅均逾6%；台積電ADR大跌4.52%，聯電ADR重挫6.51%。

台股遇四天長假 但風險不放假

台股周四早盤一度衝上47,332點高位，終場收在46,041點，單日高低點劇烈震盪1,290點並跌破季線。資深分析師周代運在臉書指出，費半指數前一天才漲1.97%，昨晚又一氣回吐三倍多，連上周五的收盤點位都踩破，市場歸咎於AI燒錢疑慮再起，加上油價往100美元靠近。

他分析，好消息是美元指數維持平盤，並非全球搶現金逃命的恐慌，熱錢還在，這點非常關鍵。由於台股連放四天假，美股周四晚、周五與周一照常交易三個交易日，下周二台股要把帳一口氣算完。

周代運認為，這次比較像殺本益比，不像金融體系出事，真卡流動性時美元通常會被搶，今天美元紋風不動。下周二開盤前，他會緊盯周一晚上費半收在哪以及油價變化，並強調「交易所可以放假，風險不放假」。

news.Title: 薔琵意外變成「護國神風」？休市一天 網喊：救了台股
news.Content:
受颱風薔琵影響，北北基桃宣布今（23）日停止上班上課。隨著台北市停班，台股、期貨及台北外匯市場也同步休市一日。此消息在PTT引發熱烈討論，有網友慶幸表示「今天的颱風假救了台股！」，甚至直呼薔琵是「護國神風」；不過也有人憂心，休市長達4天，下周二開盤時大盤漲跌幅恐將超過5%。

許多股民對於「幸運躲過一劫」大感慶幸，紛紛留言：「誰再跟我說颱風天要開市試試看」、「閃崩颱步」、「台股也懂閃身步」、「二條命躲崩 無敵了」、「多兩條命……再躲不了就是命中註定了……」、「放假躲崩！」。

同時，也有許多網友發揮幽默感，拿颱風名稱「薔琵」大玩諧音與迷因梗，笑稱「琵眼萬歲！！！！！！」、「琵眼派對」、「這次的放假可稱之為琵眼共識」、「護國神風 神山蛋雕」。

躲崩還是關廁所？ 下周開盤成焦點

不過，市場對「休市躲崩」的觀點呈現兩極化。部分網友主張休市能暫緩市場恐慌情緒，諷刺先前提議「股市應與颱風假脫鉤」的說法：「哪個說要脫鉤的？ 還好有躲崩」、「哪個捲毛說要開市的」、「是誰說股市要颱風假脫勾的？！不懂事的傢伙」。

另一方面，也有不少理性或悲觀的投資人提醒，颱風假只是延後開盤時間，累積的跌幅終究需要面對，紛紛表示：「躲崩=開盤跌停」、「上次關稅也是關廁所四天 出來直接兩根跌停」、「下星期二沒有拉起來 就是一路接鬼進大凶2027了」、「星期二要一次跌9.x%了…」、「照某人希望 颱風天照開市的玩法 今天一堆人躺平 可黏哪」、「照某人希望 颱風天照開市的玩法 今天一堆人躺平 可黏哪」、「週二百檔跌停 貪狗上山頭」。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 台股暴跌846點免驚？ 郭哲榮：4天後將大逆轉
news.Content:
台股22日上演劇烈震盪，加權指數開盤上漲413.05點，盤中最高來到47332.18點，隨後賣壓湧現翻黑，最低下探46041.43點，盤中高低震盪達1290.75點，終場大跌846.34點。摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮分析，突如其來的颱風假，加上四天連假期間無法交易的不確定性，讓部分資金選擇提前賣股避險，成為短線下跌的原因之一。不過，他認為，若假期過後市場情緒逐漸穩定，台股仍有反彈機會，這波修正也可作為第四季觀察布局時機的參考，但後續走勢仍須視國際情勢與市場資金變化而定。

四天連假後必反轉

除了連假效應，郭哲榮也將目光放在國際地緣政治局勢，認為未來四天假期期間，俄烏衝突或美伊關係若出現和談進展，可能牽動國際油價及市場對通膨的預期。他分析，若衝突降溫、油價回落，全球通膨與升息疑慮有機會緩解，進而改善市場風險偏好，讓近期受到壓抑的科技股及AI相關族群迎來反彈契機。

點名國巨、華新科、環球晶

在操作策略方面，郭哲榮提醒，面對市場大幅震盪，應避免過度使用融資槓桿，以免股價回檔時承受過大壓力，甚至遭遇追繳或斷頭風險。他看好的觀察族群包括被動元件廠國巨（2327）、華新科（2492），以及矽晶圓族群環球晶（6488）、台勝科（3532），半導體供應鏈精材（3374）也在名單之中；此外，他也關注受惠半導體擴產題材的光通訊與共同封裝光學（CPO）概念股，以及股價處於相對低基期的鴻海（2317）。至於台積電（2330），他則看好其長線發展價值。

news.Title: 台股周年慶來了！欣興、聯茂等10檔優先鎖定 2類不要碰
news.Content:
台股昨（22日）跌破季線，回測46K大關，且周四美股重挫，台積電ADR暴跌4.52%，台股今（23日）因為颱風假暫時躲過一劫，但在盤勢疲弱之際，後市並不是非常樂觀。由於台股大盤疲弱，此時如何選股相當重要，分析師陳威良坦言，這時是優質股的「周年慶機會」。

超額報酬機會來了！低檔布局好機會？

以權值股台積電與大立光為例，台積電基本面持續成長，但股價卻出現拉回，每當這兩種狀況出現，其實往往是賺取超額報酬的機會，目前沒有任何一家法人的目標價在3000元以下，拉回反而是好機會。

陳威良於直播中提到，大立光雖在季線附近，但投信一直在買，並沒有因為股價從7460元拉回而撤退，反而持續加碼；外資也在近期回頭買超大立光，展現低檔布局的企圖心，因此就算大立光在往下修正一些，依然是替明年布局的好機會。

看好載板、CCL及設備！兩大族群先不要碰

另外，陳威良提到載板、CCL及設備族群，欣興、南電、景碩及臻鼎-KY存在低檔布局機會；銅箔基板CCL聯茂、台光電及台燿等強勢股拉回並不需要太擔心，基本面仍是最大靠山，股價都會反映。

設備股中，陳威良點名大量，強勢股拉回維持上升趨勢，法人已給予2000元目標價，且毛利率從第二季的44.2%跳升超過10%，受惠於PCB擴產、CPO及半導體，且高階設備比重會增加至70%。

至於此時不該碰的族群，陳威良提到，炒作過頭的光學股，或者新材料族群PTFE等跌幅很重，「這些股票本來就是極為短線，真要碰要拿得起放得下，設好停利停損，畢竟基本面是不到位的。」

news.Title: 費半崩跌逾6%！ 台指期夜盤失守46K 日韓股也遭殃
news.Content:
金融市場對AI資本支出上升的不安情緒加深、國際油價飆升影響，美股費半指數崩跌6.72%，連帶日韓股同步下殺，韓股KOSPI指數早盤一度下跌逾4%，來到5300點，日經225指數也下跌逾2%，台指期夜盤同步跳水，最低來到45648點失守46K，最終收在45654，下跌580點，跌幅1.25%

Meta財報雖然優於預期，但由於AI資本支出持續攀升，近十年來首次出現自由現金流由正轉負，而Meta宣布，將通過2比1拆股方式發行無投票權股票以籌措資金，Meta五年期信用違約交換(CDS)報價，也創下這類合約約一年前開始活躍交易以來最高；消息曝光後，公司股價應聲下跌近7%，進而影響AMD、輝達、美光、CoreWeave等科技巨頭股價同步下挫。

除了科技股資本支出帶來的疑慮，根據《紐約時報》引述消息人士指出，美國與以色列計劃在美國期中選舉後對伊朗發動新一輪攻擊，美國總統川普更直言「很快就會發生某些事情」，讓原油價格再度攀升，影響資金出逃。

亞股也受美股下挫影響，韓股KOSPI指數早盤一度下跌逾4%，來到5300點，日經225指數也下跌逾2%，台股今（23）日雖受颱風假影響未開盤，不過前一交易日終場收跌846點、失守季線，台指期夜盤同步跳水，最低來到45648點失守46K，最終收在45654，下跌580點，跌幅1.25%，下週開盤恐面臨龐大的修正壓力。

news.Title: AI交易風向球跌！南韓KOSPI率亞洲股市下挫 日元和美債成避風港
news.Content:
科技股賣壓加劇， 被視為人工智慧(AI)交易風向球的南韓KOSPI指數周五(23日)早盤下挫，權值晶片股隨美股前日賣壓走弱，MSCI亞太股市連續第二天下跌，回落至7月以來的水準附近。美股期貨乏力，那斯達克100指數期貨下跌0.1%。

KOSPI截稿前跌幅為1.8%，盤中一度下跌3.1%，正邁向連續第四周周線收黑。三星電子下跌逾2%，SK海力士(SK Hynix)早盤跌3%，該公司正式中止Solidigm在美國的首次公開發行(IPO)計畫，另尋美國建廠資金來源。

日本日經225指數盤中跌1.3.%或854點。台灣股市受颱風影響，周五休市。

AI交易重挫之際，投資人尋求避險，公債和日元受益。美國公債周四創下逾兩年來最大漲市之後，周五續揚，殖利率反向走低，10年期美債殖利率周五報4.96%，日本和澳洲公債同步上漲。日元在亞洲早盤升值0.4%，報156.20。

韓股10月跌20% 全球最差

隨著市場擔憂大規模AI投資能否持續、借貸成本恐不斷攀升，韓股正飽受賣壓，KOSPI 10月至今已下跌約20%，成為全球主要股市中10月表現最差的市場。

由於韓股的AI概念股占比高，走勢經常隨著投資人對情緒波動而起伏。Fibonacci Asset Management Global執行長Jung In Yun說：「投資人愈來愈質疑，大規模AI支出究竟需要多久才能轉化為可持續的現金流，而油價上漲又增添了一層不確定性。市場情緒看來相當脆弱，投資人優先考慮保本，而不是逢低買進。」

根據韓國金融投資協會(Korea Financial Investment Association)，南韓券商的投資人存款餘額已降至90兆韓元(679億美元)以下，為1月以來首見。交易員指出，存款餘額下降意味著散戶對股市的支撐力道可能有限。

news.Title: 從「晶片荒」到「紅海」？ 輝達黃仁勳：2029年記憶體市場過剩可能性不大
news.Content:
過去一週，全球記憶體晶片股遭遇劇烈拋售，市場瀰漫著對供應過剩與需求疲軟的擔憂，但輝達執行長黃仁勳週四(22日)在德國GTC大會期間公開反駁這一悲觀論調，為市場注入一劑強心針。

引發本輪拋售潮的導火線，是韓媒上周援引專家觀點報導警告，隨著大量新增產能開出，預計到2029年半導體市場將變成「紅海」，超級週期可能結束，行業恐將進入低迷期。受此影響，美股記憶體族群週四集體重挫，其中閃迪大跌8.51%，SK海力士跌8.07%，美光科技跌6.23%，Roundhill記憶體ETF(DRAM)亦重挫7.08%。

面對市場恐慌，黃仁勳在柏林受訪時展現極度樂觀的態度。他明確表示：「到2029年出現記憶體供應過剩的可能性不大。」他指出，記憶體技術的獨特之處在於「你永遠可以用得更多」。

黃仁勳強調，HBM在未來數年仍將是核心零組件，並提到輝達是首家將手機用的LPDDR記憶體引入資料中心的公司，這種創新使其能效達到業界標準的兩倍，未來將繼續大量採用此類記憶體。

儘管黃仁勳試圖安撫市場，但週四美股科技板塊依然大跌，那斯達克收跌2.6%。分析人士指出，除地緣政治緊張局勢外，黃仁勳關於「資本短缺制約AI擴張」的言論，以及Meta披露的天價支出計畫，反而加劇市場對科技巨頭舉債建設AI基礎設施的擔憂。

不過，從基本面來看，需求依然強勁。美國Western Digital週四公佈的財報顯示，第一財季淨營收達43.8億美元，大幅年增55%，調整後EPS達4.64美元，均大幅優於市場預期，顯示在AI浪潮推動下，記憶體市場的「多空交戰」仍將持續。

news.Title: Meta自由現金流轉負！ 費半慘崩逾6% 台積電ADR也跌4.5%
news.Content:
在市場對AI成本支出上升的不安情緒加深，以及中東局勢緊張、油價走揚的背景下，美股週四表現分歧，道瓊指數小漲0.02%；那斯達克指數則大跌2.6%，創下自6月初以來最大單日跌幅；標普500指數下滑1.21%，為7月來最糟單日表現；費城半導體指數重挫6.72%，台積電ADR也下跌4.52%。

Meta財報表現優於分析師預期，但由於AI支出持續攀升，近十年來首次出現自由現金流由正轉負，Meta宣布，將通過2比1拆股方式發行無投票權股票以籌措資金；消息曝光，公司股價應聲下跌近7%；AI雲端基礎設施主要供應商的CoreWeave，也因債券殖利率及信用違約交換利率仍在高檔，股價重挫逾10%。

其餘半導體類股也同步走弱，AMD重挫8.1%，輝達下跌4.4%，美光跌幅達6.26%，特斯拉的季度獲利雖然優於市場預期，但因下修全年資本支出至200億美元，股價也下跌3.1%。

此外，《紐約時報》引述消息人士指出，美國與以色列計畫於美國期中選舉後再次對伊朗發動攻擊，讓國際油價再度攀升。美國總統川普21日則表態，華盛頓不會與德黑蘭展開談判，並表示「很快」將有結果，市場持續緊張的中東局勢可能讓通膨居高不下，使聯準會繼續維持升息壓力。

（封面示意圖／CANVA）

news.Title: 台股靠颱風假躲過一劫…下周補跌？散戶操盤有2種解法
news.Content:
台股今（23日）颱風假休市，要等到光復節連假過後，下周二才會恢復交易，因此台股算是躲過周四美股暴跌，台積電ADR慘摔4.52%的衝擊。資深外匯專家李其展建議投資人，操作上盡量靈活一點，如果沒有信心能低買到好企業，應考慮市值型ETF或者乾脆先觀望，等這一波利空過去，也是不錯的選擇。

美股慘崩怎辦？專家解答

科技股又成為殺盤重心，Meta暴跌6.98%，亞馬遜重挫4.57%，Google母公司Alphabet也摔3.08%，半導體與人工智慧族群慘烈，輝達下跌4.40%，超微AMD重挫8.10%，美光也下殺6.26%，資金流入傳產、金融、能源及醫藥族群。

李其展於臉書自曝操作，「這一波還是走買Alpha賣Beta路線。」李其展指出，那斯達克與費半是主要受創區，但道瓊一度翻紅，顯示防禦性類股有買盤支撐的分歧，而不是全面拋售。

言下之意代表，專注在個股操作，先剔除大盤整體的漲跌風險，通常用在看不清整體市場大盤會往哪裡走，但很確定某些標的特別強、某些特別弱的時候。李其展也建議投資人若沒有把握挑到好公司，觀望或市值型ETF也是好方法。

搶進債市？千萬不要有這個心態

資金離開高估值族群後，除了值轉進其他類股避險，債市也分一杯羹，10年期美債殖利率跌破5%。李其展直言「美債投資人等來春天」投資級與非投資級債都跟著反彈，看起來是固定收益相關的有資金流入，不是單純避險買盤支撐。

另外，李其展觀察，有一點值得注意，股市有壓力資金進公債合理，尤其歐洲債務也有風險的環境下，但通常非投資級債不受惠，這次目前卻還不錯。李其展建議投資人，以資產配置或現金流的角度投資債券，而不是賺取利差為目標。

news.Title: 費半崩近7％台股剉咧等！黃仁勳戳中AI痛點 說出市場最怕的事
news.Content:
美股科技股再掀拋售潮，輝達執行長黃仁勳一席話，戳中AI熱潮痛點，費城半導體指數重挫近7％，台積電ADR及輝達下跌逾4%，拖累台指期夜盤昨（22）日下殺580點收4萬5654點，失守46K大關。受颱風影響，台股暫時避開美股重挫的直接衝擊，但下周二恢復交易後，仍將面臨國際科技股下跌的壓力。

市場賣壓主要來自兩大因素。首先，中東地緣政治風險升溫，沙烏地阿拉伯遭遇致命攻擊，加深市場對原油供應中斷的憂慮。《紐約時報》引述知情人士指出，美國與以色列正計畫於美國期中選舉結束後，再度對伊朗發動軍事打擊，推升布倫特原油價格突破每桶113美元，通膨疑慮再度升高。

其次，AI投資所需的龐大資金引發市場不安。Meta預估，未來幾年為支應AI布局，將需要籌措數千億美元，最快今年秋季啟動融資。消息公布後，Meta股價重挫近7%，市值蒸發約1240億美元。隨著Alphabet等科技巨頭大舉發債，加上Anthropic、OpenAI等企業籌備上市，市場資金競爭日益激烈，科技業的融資壓力逐漸浮現。

輝達執行長黃仁勳受訪時更指出，新興雲端服務需求強勁，但資金供給不足，已成為產業發展的瓶頸。市場擔憂，當AI投資規模持續擴大，企業能否順利取得資金，以及投資報酬能否支撐龐大支出，都將成為影響科技股估值的關鍵。

黃仁勳點出新雲端的發展瓶頸，目前缺乏推動成長的營運資金，因為AI各領域的需求龐大，導致資金短缺。

黃仁勳這番說法，也呼應了近期博通執行長陳福陽的疑慮。陳福陽表示，資金短缺是限制AI發展的最大阻礙，並非晶片供應。

因回收投資所需的時間超出預期，市場對企業AI基礎建設支出規模抱持的疑慮加深，正讓市場感到不安。

news.Title: 看好2027年美股！避險基金大亨艾克曼：若戰爭與通膨降溫 市場將迎來強勁一年
news.Content:
潘興廣場資本(Pershing Square)執行長艾克曼(Bill Ackman)周四(22日)說，俄烏衝突、美伊戰爭、高通膨與高利率正壓抑本應更強勁的市場環境，但隨著地緣政治風險緩解、能源價格回落，「2027年將是令人驚艷的一年」。

他在接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，美伊戰爭「執行得極為出色」，認為中東若走向和平，不僅有利該區，也將惠及美國。他的樂觀判斷核心在於：戰事不確定性消退→油價大跌→通膨壓力減輕→Fed貨幣緊縮壓力下降。

今年以來，美國原油價格累計上漲72%、布蘭特期油漲78％，能源成本已明顯傳導至消費端；美國9月CPI年增3.7％，汽油貢獻當月漲幅一半以上。

目前利率維持高位，一方面壓抑本益比與經濟活動，另一方面若過早放鬆又恐讓通膨黏著，Fed陷入兩難。艾克曼坦言，上述好轉前提仍取決於地緣局勢與通膨走勢能否如預期改善。

個股布局上，他持續看好Netflix稱市場對內容儲備的擔憂被誇大，目前本益比約18倍處歷史低位，獲利可維持中高個位數至雙位數增長，「Netflix像一種高成長公用事業公司」。

Meta則是艾克曼的核心持股，他看好個人AI智能體Muse與廣告業務受惠AI，認為市場不應只看財報隔日股價反應，當前估值仍低估。

艾克曼還重申對房利美、房地美的看多立場，稱兩家機構資本基礎已重建至歷史水準五倍，「這些股票將漲十倍」，是風險報酬最不對稱的標的。

整體而言，即便短期受戰爭與高利率壓制，艾克曼仍押注優質企業長期盈利與估值修復空間。

news.Title: 1分鐘讀財經》台積電ADR狂殺 夜盤又遭血洗！主動式ETF押「這3檔」保命？
news.Content:
小編今天（23）日精選5件國內外重要財經大事。由於市場對科技巨頭砸巨資投入AI的投資報酬率疑慮再起，美股週四（22日）科技與晶片股淪為重災區，費城半導體指數大幅重挫6.72%。其中台積電ADR暴跌4.52%，導致台指期夜盤終場狂跌580點，收在45,654點，失守46,000點大關。不過，台股今（23日）正好碰上颱風假休市，暫時躲過了這波崩盤賣壓。

台股近日跌破重要均線，多空交鋒持續升溫，伴隨盤勢劇烈震盪，各家主動式ETF經理人選股策略原先高度集中在科技股持股的版圖開始洗牌，目前僅剩台積電、台光電、聯發科三檔穩居ETF標配陣容，22日跌破季線，更見經理人狂加金融與傳產股。

【1】台股破季線 主動式ETF趁低掃貨

盤點22日主動式ETF經理人逢低進場掃貨標的，涵蓋台積電、鴻海、日月光投控、聯電等科技權值龍頭，還有台泥、南亞、台化、大成鋼、華航、中華電等低基期傳產股，另有欣銓、聯茂、台燿與力積電等電子零組件個股入列。值得注意的是，欣興、奇鋐、南亞、聯茂、日月光投控及中信金等6檔，更獲得至少2檔主動式台股ETF逢低同步加碼，成為經理人共識的低檔加碼首選。

【2】聯發科法說倒數 雙外資送暖

繼台積電與大立光之後，市場最關注的科技法說會聯發科，將在30日舉行。花旗環球證券指出，市場一直對聯發科TPU開發進度，以及新專案拓展抱持懷疑態度，但聯發科TPU v8專案進展符合預期，今年相關營收可望達到20億美元以上，將成為推動第四季營收強勁成長的重要催化劑（catalyst）；野村證券則提出，市場對聯發科部分擔憂過度，重申「買進」投資評等。

【3】勞保費率明年調升為13％ 雇主年成本增逾百億元

勞動部勞保局22日指出，依《勞工保險條例》規定，勞工保險保險費率自明年1月1日起，由現行12.5％調整為13％，經扣除內含的就業保險費率1％，2027年起，將以12％計收勞工保險保險費。據估算，雇主明年全年可能因此增加逾133.3億元的法定成本。

【4】AI基建燒錢 Meta自由現金流轉負 降至負21.2億美元

Meta公布第三季財報，營收創歷史新高，第四季財測也優於市場預期，但AI軍備競賽的代價浮現。公司調高2026年資本支出預估下限，自由現金流更創上市以來首度轉負，22日早盤股價重挫逾6％。

【5】特斯拉Q3業績報喜 下修全年資本支出

特斯拉第三季業績報喜，營收和獲利雙雙優於市場預期，且資本支出低於華爾街預測，讓上季現金流意外轉正，該公司同時下修全年資本支出。

news.Content:
財經中心／李明融報導

美國科技巨頭Meta最新財報掀起全球資本市場的「AI支出恐慌」，美股晶片與科技族群周四（22日）慘遭血洗！儘管Meta第三季營收締造新猷，但龐大的AI資本支出承諾與十多年來首見的現金淨流出，引發市場對高額融資與投資報酬率的嚴重焦慮，拖累那斯達克指數重挫2.6%、費城半導體指數狂瀉6.7%。指標晶片股全面遭到無情拋售，超微（AMD）崩跌逾7%、台積電ADR大跌超過4.5%，連帶引爆台股夜盤劇烈動盪，台指期夜盤盤中不敵龐大賣壓一度狂殺500點、摜破46,000點大關，觸及45,733點低檔，市場避險情緒急速升溫。

費半狂瀉6.7%創波段最慘，台積電ADR跌逾4.5%。（圖／民視新聞資料照）

Meta加碼AI爆現金淨流出！費半狂瀉6.7%創波段最慘　台積電ADR跌逾4.5%

綜合外媒報導，Meta週四股價重摔7%，成為引爆科技股骨牌效應的核心震央。雖然該公司單季營收創下歷史新高，但財報揭露未來將新增數十億美元支出，甚至計畫發行無表決權股票以支應AI龐大融資需求，直接導致Meta出現逾十年來首度「現金淨流出」；投資人對科技巨頭在利率居高不下之際「能否拿出實質AI投資回報」產生強烈質疑，市場策略師直言這波恐慌讓投資人把嬰兒與洗澡水一起倒掉。恐慌賣壓迅速擴散至整個半導體板塊，費城半導體指數單日暴跌6.7%，創下6月下旬以來最大單日跌幅，英特爾、超微（AMD）、晟碟及邁威爾全面重挫逾8%，半導體設備龍頭科林研發即便財報優於預期亦暴跌11.8%；權值王台積電ADR同樣難逃調節賣壓，大跌逾4.5%，輝達也急跌超過3.5%，AI供應鏈全面淪為重災區。

台指期夜盤崩跌500點，黃仁勳憂融資缺口。（圖／民視新聞資料照）

台指期夜盤崩跌500點失守4萬6！黃仁勳憂融資缺口地緣火藥味推升避險情緒

在美股重挫與台積電ADR走疲的夾擊下，台指期夜盤週四開盤後雖一度翻紅力抗，但隨後遭遇龐大避險空單襲擊，指數急轉直下狂跌500點，最低下探45,733點，直接摜破46,000點整數大關。輝達執行長黃仁勳日前更直言，產業現階段缺乏足夠資金支應新型雲端基礎設施業者的擴張，進一步加深市場對融資鏈脆弱的疑慮；雪上加霜的是，中東地緣政治風暴同步升溫，沙烏地阿拉伯再傳遇襲加上美以重新規劃行動的傳聞，推動布蘭特原油大漲4%、收在每桶113.17美元，引發市場對通膨重燃與金融情勢緊縮的擔憂。恐慌資金大舉湧入美國公債避險，美債殖利率創下一年來最大降幅

news.Title: 〈美股盤後〉Meta重燃AI交易恐慌 費半狂瀉近7% 台積電ADR跌超4.5%
news.Content:
Meta 財報重燃華爾街人工智慧 (AI) 交易恐慌後，科技股暴跌。投資人紛紛拋售晶片股，轉而投資更具防禦性的板塊。費半指數週四 (22日) 狂瀉近7%，那斯達克指數下跌2.6%，創下四個多月以來的最大單日跌幅，債市出現逾 1 年來最大單日漲勢。

中東局勢升溫，推升油價觸及 5 個月高點，也加深市場不安，資金轉向美債避險，10年期公債殖利率跌破5%。

市場傳出，美國與以色列正研擬在美國期中選舉後，再度對伊朗發動攻擊的計畫，加上沙烏地阿拉伯機場及油田遇襲並傳出死傷，進一步升高能源供應疑慮。

《華爾街日報》週四引述美國官員報導，美國總統川普週三致電 SpaceX 執行長馬斯克，要求解除對烏克蘭軍用版星鏈 (Starlink) 的限速措施。美烏官員表示，通話後，系統運作已於週四改善，但尚未完全恢復正常。

經濟數據方面，美國上週初領失業金降至19.4萬人，創三個月新低，低於預期，顯示裁員活動仍維持低檔。

隨著科技股下挫、市場金融條件收緊，投資人下修聯準會 (Fed) 年內再度升息的預期，貨幣市場已不再完全反映年底前升息 1 碼的可能性。

美股週四 (22 日) 主要指數表現：

道瓊工業指數上漲 11.89 點，或 0.02%，報 52,867.98 點。

那斯達克指數下跌 694.00 點，或 2.60%，報 26,008.86 點。

S&P 500 指數下跌 93.74 點，或 1.21%，報 7,663.43 點。

費城半導體指數下跌 773.58 點，或 6.72%，報 10,731.98 點。

NYSE FANG+ 指數下跌 587.66 點，或 3.12%，報 18,260.12 點。

焦點個股

NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭僅蘋果收紅。Meta (META-US) 重挫 6.98%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 1.23%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 下跌 3.15%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 2.23%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 4.57%。

半導體主要個股全面下挫。AMD (AMD-US) 重挫 8.10%；博通 (AVGO-US) 下跌 4.31%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 4.40%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 重挫 8.16%；高通 (QCOM-US) 下跌 2.88%。

記憶體與儲存族群全面重挫。美光 (MU-US) 下跌 6.26%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 下跌 6.43%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下跌 8.51%；希捷 (STX-US) 下跌 7.86%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 下跌 8.07%。

台股 ADR 跌多漲少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 4.52%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 重挫 11.01%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 下跌 6.51%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 上漲 2.57%。

企業新聞

威騰電子 (WDC-US) 週四收低超 6%，盤後續跌超 4%，儘管威騰電子盤後公布最新財報與財測均優於預期，仍難抵 AI 概念股整體走弱的壓力。分析指出，投資人持續擔憂硬碟產業榮景能否延續，加上東芝計劃於 2027 會計年度將 AI 資料中心用硬碟產能提高至原來的 2 倍，引發市場對供給增加、威騰電子議價能力及毛利率成長空間受壓的疑慮。

Facebook 母公司 Meta (META-US) 下跌 7%。Meta 第 3 季財報表現穩健，營收優於華爾街預期。儘管當季資本支出低於預期，公司仍上調全年資本支出預估中間值，且第 3 季自由現金流轉為負值，這是自公司 IPO 以來首次出現負自由現金流。

同時，Meta 的 5 年期信用違約交換 (CDS) 利差週四升至歷史新高，顯示隨著公司持續擴大 AI 支出，投資人對其信用風險的疑慮升溫。

特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 收黑 3.1% 至每股 374.58 美元。馬斯克旗下這家電動車製造商第 3 季獲利略優於預期，營收則與去年同期大致持平。不過，隨著新技術投入增加，營業利益不如預期。

SpaceX (SPCX-US) 下殺 9.1% 至每股 144.75 美元，主要隨半導體大盤下滑，加上特斯拉財報電話會議也未提供SpaceX 與特斯拉潛在合併案的進一步消息。此外，《路透》報導，部分參與協商人士擔心，馬斯克公開支持合併，可能引發股東對交易公平性的質疑，並拖慢協商進度，為交易前景增添變數。

科林研發 (LRCX-US) 慘崩約 12% 至每股 230.15 美元，是標普最差的成分股之一。這家半導體設備製造商第 1 季度獲利雖略優於華爾街預期，仍難以滿足投資人對 AI 相關企業的高度期待。

華爾街分析

BMO Capital Markets 策略師 Ian Lyngen 表示，科技股估值修正，促使投資人重新思考聯準會 (Fed) 政策方向。若股市下跌已使金融條件收緊，Fed 進一步緊縮的必要性可能降低，這也帶動市場下修年底前再度升息的押注。

Edward Jones 經濟學家 James McCann 指出，科技股經歷大幅上漲後，市場越加要求企業拿出 AI 投資回報的具體證據，高利率也讓投資人更加質疑龐大支出能否持續。他仍看好大型股，但提醒投資人維持投資組合的分散配置。

黑石總裁 Jon Gray 則淡化 AI 泡沫疑慮，表示 AI 需求正急速成長。他認為，典型泡沫往往是先擴建產能，再期待需求出現，但目前 AI 產業的情況是需求強勁，供給仍努力追趕。

不過，Citadel 創辦人 Ken Griffin 日前警告，目前 AI 熱潮中「幾乎肯定存在泡沫」。他也指出，重大經濟轉型往往伴隨泡沫，但仍可能孕育出長期勝出的企業。

news.Title: 友達ADR22日下跌0.81美元跌幅7.06%折台股34.69元
中華電信ADR22日上漲1.22美元漲幅2.57%折台股158.38元
聯電ADR22日下跌1.29美元跌幅6.51%折台股120.47元
名師操盤》台股崩盤怎麼辦？蔡正華：鎖定3大多頭火種
news.Content:
儘管美股出現反彈，但在市場提前反應盤後所公布的企業財報，市場對於AI基建的回報時間以及融資成本擔憂持續下，亞洲科技股普遍走弱。周四的台股，反映投資人對於AI產業的疑慮，加上颱風恐停班，以及後續光復節連假在即，指數呈現開高走低，早盤最高來到47332點後，隨即不願抱股過節的賣壓出籠。

行情一路走低，終場下跌846點，以46041點作收，收在全日最低，K線收黑K，成交量為8792億元，較前一日的8331億元，呈現價跌量增，顯示隨著連假在即，加上多方未能續攻，市場心態轉趨保守，不少籌碼轉為隔日沖，寧願先離場，等待美股財報及連假變數釐清再說。

以日K線來看，週三多方一度嘗試抵抗，但是週四行情隨即再創新低，顯示多方抵抗失敗，同時週四收盤也跌破了季線支撐，目前季線位置約在46207點，短線持續由空方主導。在日級別日出訊號出現前，行情仍有探底風險。

若以週K線來看，由於上週剛出現週級別日落訊號，等於中線由多翻空，本來就需要時間整理，先前預估至少2~3週。本週的週K線由於至今未能拉出下影線，行情暫無轉折訊號(如十字或小紅)，故整理期拉長難免，先觀察日K線何時不再破底，週K線何時能否轉折，而由於週K線仍由空方佔上風，權值電子易被壓抑，操作仍以中小型股為先，多方火種也在其中。

至於OTC指數，本波由於率先跌破季線，季線成為上檔反壓，目前的架構比加權指數還要弱勢。先前提過OTC指數有下探年線的風險，目前看來測試年線的機率持續增加。以台股的日KD指標來看，目前日KD值一度收斂未果，反而向下擴大，現已雙雙跌落到20以下，進入弱勢格局。一旦KD值進入弱勢格局，行情將持續被壓抑，多方若要維繫人氣，至少要適時表態，否則人氣會退潮。

盤面上，個股跌多漲少，顯示資金普遍站在賣方，追價力道偏於保守。週三嘗試反彈的低軌衛星、CPO、液冷散熱、被動元件等，週四隨即遭遇強烈空抵，顯示籌碼仍不穩。反而先前提過的轉型CPO族群、PCB供應鏈(含銅箔基板、玻纖布)，還有AI資訊安全股、中線多頭結構並未被破壞，初步可視為多頭火種，值得持續追蹤。

news.Title: Up 3,700%, Should You Buy Sandisk Right Now?
news.Content:
The appreciation of Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) stock has been nothing short of phenomenal. Since its formal separation from Western Digital in February 2025, the stock has risen 3,700%, a feat unmatched by any large-cap stock over the same period.

Admittedly, no matter what its future holds, it is unlikely to repeat that growth within such a short time frame. However, history suggests that the chip stock is more likely to pull back than rise over time.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

The rise (and possible future decline) of Sandisk

Indeed, when Sandisk spun off, it did not appear to be on the verge of massive growth. The company specializes in NAND memory and solid-state storage products. In general, memory and storage are commoditized products, and thus, the companies in that business tend to not attract as much investor interest.

Nonetheless, the boom in AI centers led to unprecedented demand for flash storage solutions. The stock price surged as AI stock investors and institutional investors took notice. Soon after, Sandisk joined the Nasdaq-100 and the S&P 500 , leading to additional buying.

The company's financials also played a major role in its gains. Its net income was over $11 billion in fiscal 2026, far better than the $1.6 billion loss in the previous fiscal year.

That profit left it with an attractive valuation despite its massive stock gains. Currently, its P/E ratio is 19, and the immediate future appears bright as its forward P/E stands at just 6.3.

Ironically, seasoned investors' long-term memory may explain the low valuations. These shareholders know that memory companies tend to experience more volatile industry cycles than tech stocks in general. This is because memory and storage command tremendous pricing power in boom times. However, when the down cycle begins, lower demand and price cuts can reduce or even wipe out company profits.

Sandisk has signed customers into long-term contracts, which could mitigate a down cycle. Still, slumps can be exceptionally painful for memory stocks. In the nearly nine years Western Digital owned Sandisk, its stock gained over 75%. Still, since it earned all of those gains in the first year of ownership, it is easy to see why Western Digital later doubted the wisdom of the merger and decided to spin off Sandisk.

Story Continues

The performance of both Sandisk and Western Digital stocks since the separation indicates the AI boom would have ended the slump with or without the separation. Still, performance in previous years suggests storage stocks have not performed well historically, possibly pointing to pain for Sandisk in the foreseeable future.

Should you buy Sandisk stock right now?

The history of Sandisk and its industry in general suggests one should approach its stock with caution.

With Sandisk dominating the S&P 500 in 2026, it implies that it is the stock to own. Still, the stocks in that industry have faced huge sell-offs once the boom ends. That history may also explain why investors have not bid the stock higher despite its 19 P/E ratio.

Indeed, if revenue forecasts prove accurate, Sandisk stock could continue rising. Nonetheless, given Sandisk's history and the history of the memory and storage industries in general, investors should probably assume they missed out on this boom.

Fortinet (FTNT) vs. CSCO and PANW: Can Its Hardware-Software Advantage Support Long-Term Growth?
news.Content:
Is FTNT a good stock to buy? We came across a bullish thesis on Fortinet, Inc. on Astute Optics - US's Substack. In this article, we will summarize the bulls' thesis on FTNT. Fortinet, Inc.'s share was trading at $170.93as of October 20th 2026. FTNT's trailing and forward P/E were 61.58 and 45.05 respectively according to Yahoo Finance.

This isn't the first time we see a cybersecurity company pitched as a great investment. FTNT shares gained 101.90% over the last 12 months. Comparable stocks like CrowdStrike and Cisco Systems gained 81.86% and 51.02%, respectively, during the same period. Protecting businesses from cyber threats can create lasting demand, but a stock that has more than doubled also raises expectations. Does FTNT still offer an attractive buying opportunity, or has too much optimism already been priced in?

GlebStock/Shutterstock.com

In June, we published an article about the 12 Best Growth Stocks Trading in Oversold Territory and FTNT ranked #12 in that article. FTNT returned 14.34% since then. So, hedge funds were right about FTNT. This article explains why Jim Cramer favors Fortinet alongside CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks. Before getting into our analysis, let's take a look at the business and why some investors like the stock so much.

Fortinet, Inc. (NASDAQ:FTNT) provides cybersecurity solutions that combine hardware, software, and security services. Its fastest-growing opportunity right now is enterprise cybersecurity demand, and that is central to understanding the stock. As companies expand into the cloud, adopt AI, and face more sophisticated cyberattacks, they need stronger network security — an area where Fortinet specializes.

Read More: 15 AI Stocks That Are Quietly Making Investors Rich

Read More: Undervalued AI Stock Poised For Massive Gains: 10000% Upside Potential

Revenue over the past year came in at $7.5 billion, up nearly 19%, with gross margin at 80.2% and operating margin at 32.4%. Despite this strength, the stock isn't cheap: it trades at about 54 times trailing earnings and 45 times forward earnings, well above the peer median of roughly 33 times, suggesting investors are betting on several more years of growth rather than paying only for today's numbers.

The bullish case is that Fortinet can keep growing alongside the expanding cybersecurity market while converting that growth into strong cash flow. Unlike many competitors, it builds its own hardware and software together — including its FortiASIC security chips — which helps it stand out in firewall and network security markets. Results back this up: the company generated $2.2 billion in free cash flow last fiscal year, holds a net cash position of $3.6 billion, and posted a very high return on equity of about 150%.

Story Continues

Management keeps expanding the platform, including its August 2026 purchase of Virtue AI, a company focused on AI-related cybersecurity, aimed at strengthening its position in that growing niche. If businesses keep raising security spending, bulls see years of growth ahead rather than a short-lived cycle. Still, the company needs to prove it can sustain its growth rate and protect its high margins without losing ground to competitors.

Recent results support the bullish story. Second-quarter revenue grew 26% year over year to $2.05 billion, and product revenue jumped 52% to $773 million — both signs that demand is accelerating. Billings, a signal of future revenue, rose 33% to $2.37 billion, while free cash flow reached $966 million for the quarter. Following these results, management raised full-year guidance, now expecting revenue between $8.02 billion and $8.18 billion and adjusted earnings per share between $3.41 and $3.47. The stronger outlook backs the case that growth is broad-based, though investors will want to see whether this pace holds up.

Investors are also watching how durable this growth is, not just how large it is. Fortinet's high margins reflect real pricing power and scale, but holding them steady could get harder as competition rises and enterprise customers grow more selective about spending.

Valuation remains the central debate around Fortinet's stock. Bulls argue that if growth and margins keep improving, the stock could reach $220, while a base case of around $165 assumes steady execution and a stable valuation. The bear case, on the other hand, sees the stock falling toward $102 if growth slows, margins shrink, or investors decide the current multiple is too rich. That range reflects real disagreement about how much more Fortinet can grow into its premium price tag. With the stock trading at about 54 times trailing earnings and 45 times forward earnings, continued strong execution is essential to justify that premium.

AI security is a promising growth avenue, but cybersecurity spending still tends to concentrate among a relatively small group of large enterprise customers, adding some unpredictability. The Virtue AI acquisition gives Fortinet a foothold in AI security, but it still needs to show these new products can translate into meaningful revenue. Investors should also watch ongoing shareholder lawsuits and the company's reliance on specialized chip suppliers, both of which could pressure sentiment if conditions worsen.

Another risk for the stock is the potential loss of customer trust if Fortinet's security products fail to protect against cyberattacks. Customers rely on its firewalls and software to protect critical systems, so an exploited vulnerability could damage trust in the wider platform. Fortinet warns that product defects and unsuccessful security updates could expose customers to attacks or disrupt operations. Its integrated approach makes reliability across those products especially important. A serious incident could slow new sales and weaken subscription renewals. Remediation and customer support costs could also weigh on margins. In our opinion, this could pressure Fortinet's price multiples if customers question its ability to provide the protection underpinning its growth story.

Hedge fund positioning shows a strong signal for Fortinet (see why Emerald Wealth Partners is bullish on FTNT ). As per our database, 62 hedge funds held the stock at the end of the second quarter, up from 52 in the previous quarter. This notable jump suggests institutional investors are growing more confident in the company's growth prospects, profitability, and balance sheet strength, even with its rich valuation. By comparison, Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ:PANW) was held by 89 hedge funds, up from 87, Cisco Systems (NASDAQ:CSCO) was held by 101 hedge funds, up from 97, and CrowdStrike (NASDAQ:CRWD) was held by 89 hedge funds, up from 79. The increase in hedge fund ownership across Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco Systems, and CrowdStrike points to continued institutional interest in cybersecurity. CrowdStrike saw the strongest increase in conviction, while Fortinet's larger jump compared with Palo Alto Networks and Cisco Systems highlights improving sentiment despite the company's premium valuation.

Short interest data also paints a fairly calm picture for the group. Just 2.06% of Fortinet, Inc.'s float is sold short, compared with 2.66% for Palo Alto Networks, Inc., 2.60% for CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc., and 1.30% for Cisco Systems, Inc. Bearish bets remain low across all four stocks, suggesting limited outright bearish conviction. Fortinet, Inc.'s short interest sits above Cisco Systems, Inc.'s but below Palo Alto Networks, Inc.'s and CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc.'s, indicating somewhat more skepticism than Cisco Systems, Inc. faces, but less than its other two peers.

Valuation Analysis

FTNT's forward P/E is 45.05x. CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc., Cisco Systems, Inc., and Palo Alto Networks, Inc. trade at forward P/Es of 208.33x, 19.80x, and 94.34x, respectively. FTNT's own forward P/E was 27.17x on December 31, 2025, meaning its current valuation is approximately 66% higher. We believe the current valuation reflects significant investor confidence in accelerating cybersecurity demand, Fortinet's integrated platform, and its strong profitability. However, its discount to CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks does not establish a bargain, since differences in growth prospects and earnings adjustments limit direct comparisons. Fortinet, Inc.'s second-quarter adjusted earnings per share increased from $0.64 to $0.90, representing approximately 41% growth, alongside revenue growth of approximately 26%. We believe this performance supports a premium, but investors should not assume that one quarter's earnings growth will continue long enough to justify 45.05 times forward earnings, particularly after the substantial increase in its multiple. If Fortinet sustains strong earnings growth and protects its margins, profits could support further upside, but we would prefer a lower entry valuation to reduce the risk that a falling P/E offsets those gains.

Previously, we covered a bullish thesis on Fortinet, Inc. (FTNT) by Dan in January 2025, which highlighted Fortinet's AI-powered cybersecurity expansion, acquisitions, product innovation, and Secure Networking growth. FTNT's stock price has appreciated by approximately 79.94% since our coverage. We believe FTNT could be a good long-term investment at a lower price, as its premium valuation could limit returns even if earnings continue growing strongly.

Fortinet, Inc. is not on our list of the 40 Most Popular Stocks Among Hedge Funds . While FTNT could benefit from growing cybersecurity demand and expansion into AI security, we believe some AI stocks offer stronger long-term potential at more attractive valuations, with a high probability of delivering superior returns on a much shorter timeline. If you are looking for an AI stock that is more promising than FTNT and that has 10,000% upside potential, check out our report about this cheapest AI stock .

news.Title: 外資倒貨 台股上沖下洗1290點
news.Content:
台股22日開高走低，開盤先受美股激勵，早盤上漲逾400點，最高來到4萬7332.18點，沒想到薔琵颱風來攪局，加上中東戰火升溫、油價上漲，多空激戰下，走勢宛如雲霄飛車，避險、賣壓多重壓力，權值股由台積電、台達電領跌，指數急轉直下，終場大跌846.34點，收在最低點的4萬6041.43點，上下震盪1290點，4萬6千點險些失守，成交量9334億元。不過，分析師認為，等底部訊號浮現後，投資人宜偏多操作。

摩爾證券投顧分析師郭哲榮分析，台股早盤跟著美股開高，但投資人聽聞薔琵颱風要放假就先落跑，加上光復節等於連放4天假，根本不知道長假期間會發生什麼事，乾脆「先賣再說」，對台股形成龐大賣壓。

大型權值股台達電跌4％最顯著、收在1560元，聯發科也重挫3.14％、跌了130元來到4010元，台積電下跌1.45％、35元，收盤價為2385元。至於台指期夜盤昨晚間9點處於平盤上下震盪。

台股狂瀉846點摜破季線，統一投顧董事長黎方國分析，美國期中選舉，總統川普恐失國會優勢，加上美國通膨難降，聯準會10月升息仍有3成的可能性，外資昨大動作提款816億元，3大法人共賣超1001億元，種種負面雜訊對台股短線形成壓力。

郭哲榮認為，光復節連假後，台股有機會反彈向上，因為隨美國期中選舉結果揭曉逼近，台灣4天連假期間，川普很可能對美伊戰爭談判、俄烏戰爭結束宣示新進展，屆時油價就有機會下跌，股市會因此而噴出。

台股指數進入4萬6千點保衛戰，黎方國認為，台股最壞狀況已經過去，底部訊號浮現後，宜偏多操作，尤其台股第4季多呈現易漲難跌的趨勢；他指出，過去10年美股在11月有9次（年）呈現上漲，緊接的12月是台股最容易上漲月份，過去10年有8次（年）上漲，勝率相對較高。黎方國指出，我國第4季外銷訂單、出口數據仍可望維持亮眼表現，企業財報持續轉佳等基本面支撐，台股年底前上看5萬點，明年有機會朝5萬5千點前進，指數距離現在還有近8、9000點的操作空間。

美國期中選舉後國會控制權也可能重新洗牌，市場擔憂民主黨若拿下國會多數席次，恐牽制川普施政，甚至衝擊AI資料中心建設，讓高度仰賴美國科技巨頭資本支出的台股面臨考驗。

根據「鉅亨買基金」分析，選舉結果確實可能加劇短線震盪，但國會變天，不等於終結AI投資熱潮，更不代表台股多頭行情就此反轉；相較政治版圖變化，企業獲利、AI需求及資本支出能否延續，才是決定台股中長期走勢的關鍵。

news.Title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq tumble as tech stocks sink, oil prices surge
news.Content: US stocks fell on Thursday, led by the Tech ( XLK ) sector as the AI trade unwound and Wall Street assessed earnings from EV maker Tesla ( TSLA ) and social media giant ( META ). Investors flocked to bonds, sending Treasury yields lower as oil prices surged to a five-month high . The Dow Jones Industrial Average ( ^DJI ) declined 0.3%, while the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) fell 1.5%. The Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC ) tumbled 2.7% as semicondcutor stocks fell, reversing gains from Wednesday's session. Meta shares tanked as investors weighed the company's quarterly results and 2-for-1 stock split announcement. Tesla shares were volatile after an earnings beat , as investors weighed lower 2026 capex against higher spending in 2027 and 2028 on Optimus, Cybercab, and Terafab. SpaceX ( SPCX ) stock fell, giving back more than half of Wednesday's post-earnings gain. Meanwhile, Blackstone's ( BX ) stock climbed 6% following the firm's upbeat outlook for upcoming investment sales after posting weaker third quarter earnings amid elevated borrowing costs. A report that the US and Israel are preparing for renewed attacks on Iran after the US mid-term elections sent Brent crude ( BZ=F ) to $113 per barrel while West Texas Intermediate crude ( CL=F ) climbed to $100. A deadly attack at a Saudi Arabian airport and oil field also put upward pressure on energy prices. In other news, jobless claims fell to 194,000 last week , the fewest in three months, underscoring how layoffs remain low. LIVE 11 updates 11 mins ago Ines Ferré Big companies are rethinking 'out of control' AI spending — and turning to cheaper models IBM ( IBM ) is calling attention to a growing trend among companies and their AI spending: They're keeping a closer eye on it. "I think what we are seeing is that at least larger enterprises are becoming a lot more cognizant and a lot more aware of what the true ROI of all of their AI spend is," IBM CEO Arvind Krishna said during the tech company's earnings call on Wednesday. "They are also getting worried if some of the AI spending is completely out of control with no real return," he added. Today at 6:00 PM UTC Meta stock drops more than 6% despite strong Q3 results, stock split Yahoo Finance's Dan Howley reports: Bitcoin ( BTC ) fell below $82,000 early Thursday as crypto joined a broader sell-off in riskier assets amid rising geopolitical tensions. The world's largest cryptocurrency traded around $81,600 Thursday morning, down more than 3% for the last 24 hours. Other major coins also declined. Crypto's total market value fell 1.4% over the previous 24 hours, according to CoinMarketCap. Traders saw roughly $400 million in liquidations over the same period, according to data aggregator CoinGlass. Today at 4:55 PM UTC Jared Blikre The bond market is calling oil's inflation bluff If oil is about to spark an inflation wave, the bond market hasn't heard about it. The 10-year Treasury yield (^TNX) is on track for its biggest one-day drop in more than two years on Thursday, slipping back below 5% as stocks slide. The 5-year yield (^FVX) is falling even faster. Meanwhile, Brent crude (BZ=F) is hovering around $112, up more than 50% since the Iran war began in late February. The surprise is how little the oil spike has moved the bond market's inflation forecasts. The 5-year breakeven — the inflation rate implied by the gap between regular Treasurys and inflation-protected TIPS — is a bit lower now than it was before the war. The 5y5y inflation swap is the market's forecast for average inflation over the five years starting five years from now, and the Fed watches it closely for signs that expectations are slipping. It has barely moved. So the jump in yields since February has been almost all about real rates — not inflation. Traders are betting the Fed keeps policy tight enough that $110-plus oil doesn't turn into lasting inflation. Not everyone buys it. Bloomberg strategist Simon White argues breakevens are "mispricing" the oil shock. Elsewhere in bondland, France's 10-year yield is above the US 10-year for the first time since 2013. Next up is the 5-year TIPS auction at 1 p.m. ET. Bloomberg's Alyce Andres calls it a referendum on the Fed's inflation bet under Chair Kevin Warsh. Weak demand would signal investors are starting to doubt it. Today at 4:35 PM UTC Ines Ferré Bitcoin falls below $82,000 as investors retreat from risk assets David Hollerith reports: Today at 3:13 PM UTC Treasury yields retreat as AI trade comes under pressure, investors flock to bonds Treasury yields fell as investors flocked to bonds amid pressure on the AI trade. The 10-year Treasury yield ( ^TNX ), which moves inversely to bond prices, fell 11 basis points to 5.02%. The 30-year Treasury ( ^TYX ) yield also slid 10 basis points to 5.32%. Concerns over a slowdown in AI infrastructure build-outs overshadowed inflation fears stemming from higher oil prices. Today at 2:18 PM UTC Blackstone stock climbs 4% as executives give upbeat Q4 exit outlook Blackstone (BX) stock rose 4% Thursday morning, reversing earlier losses as executives at the alternative asset giant offered an upbeat outlook for investment exits and fee growth in the coming quarters. Blackstone CFO Michael Chae told analysts that performance-fee realizations from investments already under contract and expected to close in the fourth quarter would surpass the firm's total net realizations in the third quarter. He also reiterated expectations for "double-digit" growth in base management fees in 2027. The outlook offered investors some encouragement after Blackstone reported a 34% drop in net realizations during the third quarter compared with a year earlier while distributable earnings fell 9% in the same period. CEO Stephen Schwarzman described the quarterly results as "strong" amid a "volatile external environment" in a statement accompanying the earnings release. Today at 1:36 PM UTC Stocks retreat as investors digest tech earnings US stocks fell as investors digested earnings from Meta and Tesla while oil prices and government bond yields remained elevated. The Dow Jones Industrial Average ( ^DJI ) declined 0.3%, while the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) dropped 0.9%. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC ) tumbled 1.4%. Shares of Meta ( META ) and Tesla ( TSLA ) each fell more than 3% at Thursday's open while Oil prices also rose while the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield ( ^TNX ) hovered around 5%. Today at 1:25 PM UTC Jared Blikre Chip stocks break below their bear-trap low Chip bulls sprang a bear trap on Tuesday. Two sessions later, they're the ones getting caught. The iShares Semiconductor ETF ( SOXX ) is down about 4% premarket, below Tuesday's intraday low of $489.70. That was the floor of the bear trap — a breakdown that quickly reverses, catching traders betting on further losses. SOXX is on track for its lowest close since July 29. Lam Research ( LRCX ) is leading the slide, down about 9% after its results Wednesday night. Applied Materials ( AMAT ) and KLA ( KLAC ) are off about 6%, and AMD ( AMD ), Intel ( INTC ), and Sandisk ( SNDK ) are down 4% to 5%. Nvidia ( NVDA ) is off a milder 2%. SOXX is on track to flip direction for a fifth straight session, and the Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC ) for a seventh. Dip buyers keep showing up anyway. Semiconductor ETFs saw record flows over the past week, Bloomberg senior ETF analyst Eric Balchunas posted Thursday. "Buying the dip here has [a] pretty good record of working," he wrote. There's little room to hide. "Every index on the planet is basically an AI index," Manulife John Hancock Investments co-chief investment strategist Matt Miskin said on Yahoo Finance's live show Thursday. Watch whether buyers come in yet again this session. A close above $490, roughly Tuesday's trap low, keeps the bulls' hopes alive — barely. Today at 12:45 PM UTC Ines Ferré Oil prices rise to highest level since May on worries of Iran-US escalations after midterms Oil prices rose on Thursday to their highest level since May amid growing worries over an escalation of the war in the Middle East after the Nov. 3 midterm elections. Brent crude ( BZ=F ) topped $111 per barrel, while West Texas Intermediate crude ( CL=F ) hovered above $98 a barrel. The US and Israel have reportedly drawn up plans for renewed attacks on Iran after the elections next month, according to the New York Times , citing unnamed US officials. Meanwhile, Middle East tensions escalated after Saudi Arabia said it suffered attacks at the airport of Dammam and an Aramco oil field . Today at 10:30 AM UTC Ines Ferré Tesla reports Q3 earnings beat, positive free cash flow, and better-than-expected capex Yahoo Finance's Pras Subramanian reports: Tesla ( TSLA ) reported better-than-expected third quarter earnings on Wednesday, with its free cash flow and capex spending coming in ahead of Wall Street estimates. Tesla reported Q3 revenue of $28.05 billion vs. Bloomberg consensus of $28.13 billion. Tesla posted adjusted EPS of $0.48 vs. the $0.44 estimate, with adjusted EBITDA of $3.90 billion vs. $3.66 billion. Tesla stock was volatile following the earnings release. Today at 9:35 AM UTC Ines Ferré IBM shares slide as revenue outlook holds steady despite earnings beat IBM ( IBM ) shares were volatile in pre-market trading on Thursday after the company beat Wall Street's top- and bottom-line estimates and raised its full-year free cash flow forecast, but maintained its 4%-5% revenue growth guidance for 2026. Software revenue accelerated by 9%, but CFO Jim Kavanaugh said about a quarter of that growth came from closing "tens of slip deals" that were delayed from the second quarter. This suggests third-quarter software growth was partly driven by delayed revenue rather than entirely by new demand. LIVE 11 updates

news.Title: 台股推動銀行業高歌猛進　存股最推5檔
news.Content:
國內研究機構發布最新金融族群專題研究報告指出，受惠於資本市場持續熱絡、出口貿易暢旺及制度接軌革新，台灣金融控股公司整體營運展現強勁成長動能。在壽險獲利跳升、銀行放款與手續費雙增，以及證券自營與經紀業務大幅成長下，預期2026年金融族群整體營運將持續向好。銀行業務方面，受惠於出口持續暢旺，截至8月底國銀放款餘額較去年同期年增12%，帶動淨利息收益成長17.9%。此外，資本市場熱絡亦激勵手續費收入年增24.2%。觀察國銀逾期放款比率及備抵呆帳覆蓋率均維持正常水準，未見異常，顯示銀行業在獲利高歌猛進的同時，風險控制與資產品質依然良好。

新制驅動大跳升 六大壽險創佳績

壽險業在2026年接軌IFRS17新制後，負債成本大幅下降推升經常性收益增長，加上契約服務邊際（CSM）挹注與資本市場上行之金融資產評價利益，帶動獲利顯著跳升。2026上半年全體壽險業保費收入達13181億元，年增16.2%，其中首年保費收入（FYP）達5062億元，年增35.1%。截至8月底，國泰金（2882）、富邦金（2881）、新光金（2888）、南山、凱基金（2883）、旗下擁台壽的中信金（2891）等六大壽險與母金控合計稅後淨利達2207億元，年增高達2.2倍。儘管美債殖利率創高致7月產生金融資產評價損失，六大壽險7月稅後淨利僅61.2億元，但8月隨台股走揚獲利已快速回升。截至8月底全體壽險業外價金約11015億元，能有效抵禦匯率波動並降低避險成本，本土投顧法人推估全年獲利將顯著年增49.3%。

台股爆量飆兆元 自營經紀雙發動

證券業方面，受惠於股市多頭行情，台股日均成交量衝上10024億元，相較2025年日均5325億元大幅成長88.2%。資本市場波動同步挹注自營收入相較去年同期大幅跳升333.5%，帶動整體證券業前8月稅後淨利達1824.7億元，年增195%。雖然7月受美伊衝突惡化影響致自營收益稍有縮減，但9月台股日均成交量仍高居1兆1051億元。在資本利得持續挹注下，國內研究機構預計2026年證券業全年獲利將較2025年再創新高。台灣金融業在壽險、銀行與證券三大核心業務引擎同步發動下，展現出強大的抵禦波動能力與營運韌性，未來隨著各項制度接軌與資本市場熱度延續，金融族群可望持續扮演台股中堅力量。

news.Title: Better Buffett Stock: Alphabet vs. Apple
news.Content:
Former Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE: BRKA) (NYSE: BRKB) CEO Warren Buffett made several incredible investments. However, he was also noteworthy for letting some obvious ones get away.

One of those was Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG) (NASDAQ: GOOGL), which he regretted not buying sooner. However, he remedied that mistake by purchasing shares not long before leaving his role. Current CEO Greg Abel has kept purchasing Alphabet shares, showing that he's also bullish on the stock.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Another stock that Buffett identified as a major value opportunity right away was Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) in the mid-2010s. This turned out to be one of Buffett's best investments ever, and while Berkshire has sold off the number of Apple shares it owns compared to its peak holdings, it's still the largest position in its portfolio.

The question is, between the two, which one is the better buy now? I think it's Alphabet, but the answer to that question may depend on whether you're bullish on AI or not.

Alphabet is going all-in on AI

Alphabet and Apple are taking two distinct approaches to the emerging AI landscape. Alphabet is going all-in on AI, and plans to spend about $200 billion on data center capital expenditures this year. The uses for these data centers range from being rented out via its cloud computing unit (a very profitable endeavor) to being used for compute capacity for its Gemini platform (not profitable right now). Regardless, Alphabet has positioned itself as an AI-first investment, but there are those who may be a bit wary regarding Alphabet's all-in position on an emerging technology.

Apple is taking the complete opposite approach. Instead of rapidly increasing its AI computing power, it's choosing to deploy Google's Gemini model on its devices, cutting development costs substantially. While it will have to pay to utilize Gemini, the cost to develop a new model may have been far higher in infrastructure and research and development (R&D) expenses. Furthermore, the AI features that Apple has rolled out are lackluster to some, although the revamped Siri AI is receiving positive reviews. Apple still has a long way to go before AI is a top product, and it could lose market share in the smartphone market to some Android phones that are pioneering this technology.

Story Continues

We'll see what happens, but whether you're bullish on AI or not may decide which stock you prefer. Regardless, here are other concrete factors we can look at to determine which stock makes more sense from a valuation standpoint.

Apple's stock has gotten expensive

It's no secret that Apple has long been one of the most expensive big tech stocks out there. It just entered its new fiscal year and trades at an impressive 36 times fiscal 2027 earnings (ending about Sept. 30).

AAPL PE Ratio (Forward) data by YCharts

This is by far its most expensive valuation over the past few years, and could be an issue for future returns. If we assess Alphabet's stock from fiscal 2027's earnings projections, it is far cheaper.

GOOG PE Ratio (Forward 1y) data by YCharts

Alphabet trades for a mere 22 times next year's earnings, making it far cheaper. While Alphabet is one quarter behind Apple's results, which skews this figure in Alphabet's favor a little bit, it's still noteworthy enough that Alphabet is about two-thirds the price of Apple when that offset is accounted for.

Apple may be the more cash-conservative business, which Buffett would have loved; Alphabet is the cheaper stock. At the end of the day, I think Alphabet's lower stock price, combined with the major upside AI presents, makes it the better buy. Apple stock is expensive, and I might miss out on one of the most impressive technological shifts experienced in several decades. It just isn't as attractive to me, and I think there's a reason why Berkshire has been buying Alphabet stock recently and not Apple.

news.Title: Tesla, Meta, IBM: 3 earnings call shout-outs that left us thinking
news.Content:
Earnings season is in full swing, and Big Tech calls are about more than the heavy use of "superintelligence," which some read as a bid to please the White House after it reportedly disliked the term "artificial intelligence."

Here are three moments from the earnings calls of Tesla ( TSLA ), Meta ( META ), and IBM ( IBM ) on late Wednesday that stuck with us.

Tesla

Much of the focus today is on Tesla cutting its capital spending plans for this year to $20 billion from the $25 billion it guided to three months ago. A key factor appears to be that its Optimus robots need more training before they're released into the real world.

Elon Musk said investors should think of Optimus as a baby:

"A big difference with Optimus versus the cars is we don't have this vast fleet of cars from which we can gather training data. With Optimus, we have to bootstrap it by making the robots and having them do self-play, which is really how a human learns to navigate the world. You can see this when you have a toddler, and they grow up, and initially, they're sort of wobbly, and they don't know how to do things. Eventually they learn to wipe their own ass, which is a big milestone. As anyone who's had kids knows. Then they learn to read and do all sorts of things and be able to do these things. They learn this by playing. We actually need Optimus to play at scale in order to have it be really good at tasks in the real world."

Meta

Are early users of Meta's ( META ) Muse AI agent overspending? Mark Zuckerberg's comments on credit limits during the earnings call suggest they might be.

That raises a bigger question: Could AI agent shopping end badly for retailers and banks, in the form of unpaid debts and write-offs?

"The most common use case for Muse is shopping, with more than a quarter of people who are using Muse engaging in this with an average purchase size of over $200," Zuckerberg said on the call. "Plaid told us that they hadn't seen activity like they're seeing with their connector on any other service before. In the first week, we had to work with Stripe to raise credit limits since the volumes were above what any of us expected."

IBM ( IBM ) CEO Arvind Krishna seemed to be in a better place this earnings call compared to three months ago , which came on the heels of a shock earnings warning that sent the stock reeling.

It was interesting to hear Krishna call out some C-suite concerns about the current spending on AI tools:

"I think what we are seeing is that at least larger enterprises are becoming a lot more cognizant and a lot more aware of what is the true ROI of all of their AI spend. They are also getting worried if some of the AI spending completely out of control with no real return. But the way I have always characterized it is, there is no question to us, and this is the advice I give every C-suite member that I meet, that what we are trying to give people on AI, the productivity, the advantages of AI, the way it is going to change work, is very real. Let me not make any confusion around that."

Brian Sozzi is Yahoo Finance's Executive Editor, host of the Sozzi Unleashed morning show and the Power Players with Brian Sozzi podcast, and a member of Yahoo Finance's editorial leadership team.

news.Title: Meta has big plans for its Muse AI agent
news.Content:
Meta ( META ) reported better-than-anticipated Q3 results after the bell Wednesday, with revenue hitting an all-time high. The company also announced a 2-for-1 stock split, with current stockholders getting one new Class C share for each share they own.

But the most interesting news out of Meta's report was about the future of the company's Muse AI agent and models .

During Meta's earnings call, Zuckerberg said that some 10 million people in the US and Canada have set up the Muse agent app since it launched. What's more, the most common use case so far is shopping, with the average purchase size over $200.

At Meta Connect last month, Zuckerberg said that the company would generate revenue via Muse by taking a small cut on sales made using the agent . And Wednesday, the chief executive said Muse's American average revenue per user (ARPU) could eventually eclipse American ARPU on the company's social media apps, which is already several hundred dollars.

Muse, like other AI agents and apps, devours computing resources. But Zuckerberg says that Meta anticipates the service's compute cost efficiency will improve 10x in the next year.

"If compute efficiency continues to improve quickly for another few years, which we think is highly likely, then Muse will be highly profitable over multiple years," he said during the call Wednesday.

Analysts on Wall Street reacted positively to the news.

"If you assumed Meta Connect was all hype, think again," Forrester principal analyst Kate Winick wrote in a note following Meta's earnings call.

"More than 10 million new users have tried Muse since launch, and Meta is feeling good about a few key signals: retention is strong and gets stronger with time for the most active users; spending is higher than expected – the average size of a purchase made via Muse is over $200; the most common connectors are email and productivity apps, which signals that at least some users are trusting Muse with a significant amount of personal data."

BofA Global Research analyst Justin Post predicted that Wall Street would come away from Meta's earnings with a more positive outlook on the company's AI investments thanks to the Muse news.

TD Cowen analyst John Blackledge, meanwhile, wrote in a note to investors that he estimates Muse will reach more than 1 billion daily active users over the next five years, but that Meta's leadership says the app could hit that mark even sooner.

news.Title: Why Meta Platforms Stock Took a Hit Today
news.Content:
Shares of Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) stumbled out of the gate on Thursday, falling as much as 7.6%. As of 1:10 p.m. ET, the stock was still down 7.2%.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

The catalysts that sent the social media and artificial intelligence (AI) company lower were its financial results and a change to its stock structure.

Image source: The Motley Fool.

The good news

For the third quarter, Meta generated revenue that grew 26% to $64.6 billion, driven by robust advertising. This drove diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $3.83, up 265%. However, the company took a $9.9 billion charge related to its recent legal settlement regarding teen social media addiction. Excluding this charge, EPS would have been $7.40.

For context, analysts' consensus estimates called for revenue of $63.4 billion and EPS of $5.46, so if not for the charge, Meta would have easily surpassed expectations.

Other metrics were equally robust. The company's daily active users rose 3% year over year to 3.64 billion, while ad impressions and average price per ad increased 10% and 14%, respectively.

The not-so-good news

However, a change to Meta's stock structure was the headline. The company announced that its board of directors had established a new class of common stock -- non-voting Class C shares -- which will be effective Jan. 19, 2027. The company created this new class of shares to raise capital for its rising AI expenses, employee compensation, and potential acquisitions.

Meta will also use this new class of shares to effect a 2-for-1 stock split early next year, though the timing is still up in the air. The use of non-voting stock allows CEO Mark Zuckerberg to retain control of the company with a more than 60% voting interest thanks to his ownership of Class B shares, which carry 10 votes each, while regular Class A shares carry one vote each.

In other bad news, New Mexico hit Meta with a record $25 billion judgment for failing to protect user privacy in connection with the 2018 Cambridge Analytica scandal. Meta has said it will appeal.

At 22 times earnings, Meta is well below its 3-year average multiple of 27. While the stock is certainly cheap, investors should consider the risk associated with its legal exposure.

news.Title: Investors are punishing Big Tech's biggest spenders. Meta is the latest casualty.
news.Content: Apple ( AAPL ), Eli Lilly ( LLY ), and Walmart ( WMT ) have added more than $400 billion since chip stocks peaked in early October. Meta ( META ), Alphabet ( GOOG , GOOGL ), and SpaceX ( SPCX ) have lost nearly twice that. Meta is the latest casualty. The stock is down more than 7% on Thursday, erasing about $125 billion in market value and slipping below its 2025 closing price. That wipes out its gain for the year. The social media giant is also on track for its third straight drop of 5% or more the day after earnings, a first since its 2012 IPO. Meta is stuck in a 2-year box Thursday's drop looks dramatic, but on a weekly chart, it barely registers. Since mid-2024, Meta has bounced between roughly $500 and $800, from its April 2025 low near $485 to its August 2025 record close of $790. Slipping below the 2025 close turns Meta red for the year. It doesn't change the trend. Only a break out of the box would. The broader damage is hitting the AI spenders. Since Oct. 6, Apple, Eli Lilly, and Walmart have climbed while Meta, Alphabet, and SpaceX have bled, according to Yahoo Finance calculations. Nvidia ( NVDA ) alone has shed more than $600 billion as chip stocks broke a bear trap . The bill for AI is coming due Meta beat on revenue on Wednesday , with sales up 26% to $64.6 billion. But the company raised its full-year expense outlook and narrowed its capital spending plan to $135 billion to $145 billion. It also unveiled a new class of nonvoting shares it can sell to raise money. "He's not going to have the cash flow to support it. So he's going to have to raise capital, both debt and equity," Gil Luria, head of technology research at D.A. Davidson, said to Yahoo Finance in reference to Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg. Bond traders were already nervous. Earlier this week, the cost of insuring debt from Meta, Amazon ( AMZN ), Alphabet, and Microsoft ( MSFT ) climbed to its highest in months. Truist analysts wrote that Meta's AI investments "will take longer to generate returns." The core business is holding up, though. Luria said Meta is "gaining share from Google," with ad sales growing in the 20s. And Mark Zuckerberg told analysts that if compute efficiency keeps improving quickly, "Muse will be highly profitable over multiple years." Watch for a weekly close outside the box. A move above $800 would be a breakout to new highs, while a close below $500 would open the door to a much deeper slide. Until then, the moves are just noise inside the range. news.Title: Ulta Beauty's website traffic just surged a whopping 48%
news.Content:
If you shop for beauty products, you have more choices than ever. Sephora sits inside Kohl's, Amazon sells prestige brands, and Target went all-in on its own beauty push after its split with Ulta , as TheStreet reported.

That crowded field has made investors nervous about Ulta for most of 2026. The worry is simple: if shoppers can find the same lipstick anywhere, why make the trip?

Ulta is still growing anyway. Net sales rose 8.9% to $3.04 billion in the second quarter, and comparable sales climbed 3.8%, according to the company's earnings release dated Aug. 27.

"Our team delivered another impressive quarter of strong sales, profit, and earnings growth," CEO Kecia Steelman said in the release.

However, Wall Street wanted proof that growth would hold up in the back half of the year, when the comparisons get harder.

According to a Bank of America research report reviewed by TheStreet, that proof may already be showing up on Ulta's website. Visits to Ulta.com jumped 48% from a year earlier in September, the bank said, citing Similarweb data.

What Bank of America found in Ulta's web traffic

The September jump wasn't a one-off. Site visits rose 38% through the first nine months of the year, with growth above 30% every month since April, wrote BofA analyst Lorraine Hutchinson in the Oct. 20 note, titled "Higher web traffic creates opportunity for 2H comp upside." That is a long streak for a retailer whose stock was punished over growth fears just two months ago.

"Consumers are engaged, and we are optimistic about ULTA's ability to convert this higher traffic into sales," Hutchinson wrote.

Digital sales have grown at a rate between the low double digits and the mid-teens in recent quarters, the bank said, yet they make up only about 20% of revenue. Steelman said on the August call that e-commerce posted its "sixth consecutive quarter of double-digit sales growth," according to the Motley Fool transcript .

Related: Ulta Beauty's move to win back shoppers takes a new turn

That's where the bank sees upside. Ulta's guidance implies second-half comparable sales growth of 2% to 3%, and Chief Financial Officer Chris DelOrefice confirmed that range on the call.

The stock has already moved. Shares fell about 3% to $524 in after-hours trading on Aug. 27 as investors fretted about slowing growth, Investing.com reported. By Oct. 20, they stood at $591.62, according to the BofA note, a gain of roughly 13% by my math.

Beauty spending keeps beating the rest of retail

The broader category is giving Ulta room to run. Prestige beauty sales rose 7% to $17.1 billion in the first half of 2026, and mass beauty climbed 7% to $39.2 billion, according to Circana on Aug. 11.

Story Continues

More Retail :

Walmart gets unexpected boost from stubborn inflation

Bank of America sees a costly catch in America's strong economy

Bath & Body Works faces surprising problem as Americans return to malls

Skincare led prestige with 9% growth, while mass fragrance jumped 15%, Circana said. "Fragrance remains a key avenue for affordable luxury and self-expression," said Larissa Jensen, Circana's global beauty industry advisor.

Bank of America's own card data tell a similar story. Beauty spending rose 6.5% in the third quarter versus 4.8% for total retail excluding autos, the bank said, and the gap widened in September to 8.6% versus 6.3%.

Here is what Ulta and the bank point to as the drivers:

Bolder makeup: Steelman flagged "this fuller face look, more expressive eye" as a trend heading into the back half, according to the Motley Fool transcript .

Wellness: Steelman said wellness "could be one of our next big pillar categories," and BofA noted most loyalty members already buy wellness products elsewhere.

Social reach: Ulta's TikTok followers are up 27% this year and Instagram engagement is up 83%, Bank of America said in the note.

Competition: "We expect the battle for share to remain intense," Steelman said on the call.

Given that backdrop, it's easy to understand why Hutchinson thinks Ulta's heavy spending on loyalty, systems and supply chain is starting to pay off.

Why a $700 price target hinges on turning clicks into sales

The bank now values Ulta at 22 times its fiscal 2027 earnings estimate of $31.86 a share, up from 20 times. That multiple sits at the top of the 19-to-22 range for high-quality peers and below the 25 to 27 times that steady compounders fetch, Hutchinson wrote.

For the current year, BofA expects $28.74 a share, inside the company's raised guidance of $28.70 to $29.00. It sees earnings growing about 12% this year and 11% the next.

There's one catch in the data that I think investors should keep in mind. The Similarweb figures track Ulta.com only, the note says, and they exclude the app, which Steelman said accounts for "more than 60% of online sales."

That cuts both ways. The website surge could be shoppers browsing more before buying in stores, which the bank says still counts for an omnichannel retailer. It could also mean the app-heavy core of Ulta's digital business is growing more slowly than the headline number suggests.

Much will likely depend, however, on whether Ulta can turn visits into orders during a promotional holiday season. Management already acknowledged a more promotional environment in August, the Investing.com report found.

Target's exit adds another wrinkle. The traffic acceleration since April overlaps with the wind-down of Ulta's shop-in-shops inside Target stores, and in my analysis some of those shoppers may simply be finding Ulta online instead. The note doesn't make that link, so treat it as a theory worth watching in the third-quarter report.

For your wallet, a busier Ulta.com usually means more personalized offers aimed at keeping you loyal. Check your rewards account before you buy elsewhere this holiday season. I'd also compare prices across Ulta, Sephora and Amazon before checkout, since the same products often sit at all three.

Bank of America's view is that the investment cycle is turning into a harvest. "The trends support our view that ULTA can now harvest gains from prior investments and reinforce the value of ULTA's omnichannel model," Hutchinson wrote.

news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

E-commerce and cloud behemoth Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN , Financials ) is among a rising number of corporations shedding positions as expenditure moves toward artificial intelligence and automation.In January, Amazon said it was cutting 16,000 corporate jobs in a revamp targeting artificial intelligence and efficiency. The tendency is far larger than technology.HSBC is considering almost 20,000 cutbacks, Standard Chartered intends more than 7,000 reductions over four years, and Barclays is aiming for around 5,000 posts.Microsoft claimed it slashed 4,800 workers in July and Block indicated it will remove more than 4,000 people as it restructures to focus on AI.Meta, Cisco, Intuit, Cloudflare and others have similarly cut personnel while shifting resources to AI.The trend matters to investors because corporations are increasingly looking to artificial intelligence as a growth investment and a means to minimize costs.That can be supportive for margins over time, but also raises problems about execution, disturbance to the workforce and whether productivity improvements will come fast enough to warrant massive AI spending.Another area to watch: if more major corporations roll out restructuring plans once 2027 budgets are completed.

news.Title: How much MSFT stock does Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella actually own?
news.Content:
Not many people remember this, but when Satya Nadella took the reins as CEO of Microsoft in February 2014, the company was struggling to find its place amidst a tech landscape dominated by Apple's smartphones, Google's Android operating system, and Amazon's cloud computing services.

Under the leadership of Steve Ballmer, Microsoft had undertaken a contentious $7.2 billion acquisition of Nokia's mobile phone business in 2013. That deal ultimately failed, resulting in billions in write-downs and thousands of layoffs .

But Nadella did not turn the company around overnight. Over the next few years, he shifted Microsoft's business model even further into cloud computing by expanding Azure and its subscription-based services . He also made strategic acquisitions , including LinkedIn, GitHub, and Minecraft, while investing billions into artificial intelligence before it became a household name.

In fact, you could say that Nadella was instrumental in Microsoft's partnership with OpenAI, as he even personally stepped in to serve as mediator when OpenAI's board briefly fired its CEO and co-founder , Sam Altman, in the fall of 2023.

Although Microsoft and OpenAI renegotiated their once-exclusive partnership, Microsoft hasn't lost momentum. Their newest agreement , announced in April 2026, gave each greater independence and allowed Microsoft to continue to expand its own AI capabilities through Azure's cloud services.

MSFT crossed the trillion-dollar valuation threshold on April 25, 2019, and it hasn't looked back since. In its most recent earnings, the company reported that Azure revenue grew by 43% year-over-year . These results show that Microsoft isn't just one of the founders of the digital era — it's very much a power player, and as the driver behind its innovation, Nadella himself has been rewarded handsomely through salary increases, bonuses, and enormous stock awards.

How much of MSFT does Satya Nadella own? Is he the biggest inividual shareholder?

As of Microsoft's latest Proxy statement for fiscal 2025, filed in September 2025, Satya Nadella owned 900,572 shares of Microsoft, equating to about 0.01% of the company's total outstanding shares.

Given MSFT's October 19 closing share price of $533.52, those shares would be worth a whopping $480.4 million.

But Nadella isn't Microsoft's biggest individual shareholder — not by a long shot.

That distinction actually belongs to Steve Ballmer, who is estimated to still own approximately 319 million shares, or roughly 4% of Microsoft. Despite Ballmer stepping down amid Microsoft's struggles, he still owns more than 350 times as much as Nadella's stake.

Story Continues

And in case you're wondering, even Microsoft's founder Bill Gates still owns about 103 million shares , valued at approximately $43 billion . That's substantially more than Nadella — even though Gates has spent decades giving away his fortune.

Related: How much MSFT stock does Microsoft founder Bill Gates actually own?

How much stock does Satya Nadella get as part of his compensation package?

To say that Microsoft's board of directors has been happy with Nadella's efforts is an understatement. In the company's latest Proxy statement , published in October 2025, the board stated that "Our exceptional fiscal year 2025 results demonstrate that Satya Nadella and his leadership team have positioned Microsoft as a clear artificial intelligence leader for this generational technology shift, enabling Microsoft to drive long-term growth through innovation, security, and quality."

Crediting Nadella for the company's 15% annual revenue growth and 17% increase in operating income, the esteemed CEO received a 117.00% payout in annual cash incentives and a 103.69% payout in performance stock awards.

Translated into dollars and cents, Nadella compensation can be broken down as follows:

Satya Nadella's fiscal 2025 total compensation

Category

Amount

Base salary

$2,500,000

Stock awards

$84,245,496

Annual cash incentives

$9,555,000

Other compensation

$196,294

Total fiscal 2025 compensation

$96,496,790

In total, approximately 87% of Nadella's compensation was in stock awards.

The $96.5 million compensation Nadella received in fiscal 2025 was an increase of about 22% from fiscal 2024, when he made $79.1 million.

More on CEO wealth:

Warren Buffett's net worth: A look at his fortune in retirement

Mark Zuckerberg's net worth: How the Facebook founder hit $200 billion

Microsoft's largest institutional shareholders

Microsoft's largest institutional shareholder is The Vanguard Group. It holds 664,882,153 shares, or 8.95% of Microsoft, worth approximately $354.7 billion.

BlackRock Inc. is the next largest. It holds 540,020,228 shares, or approximately 7.30% of the company's total outstanding shares. Its stake is worth $288.1 billion as of MSFT's October 19 close.

news.Title: Microsoft, Google parent and McDonald’s protest new trading plan
news.Content:
Top publicly listed companies such as Microsoft (Nasdaq: MSFT), Google parent Alphabet (Nasdaq: GOOGL), Coreweave (Nasdaq: CRWV), Goldman Sachs (NYSE: GS), and McDonald's (NYSE: MCD) have joined hands to protest the inclusion of the tokenized version of their stocks on the OKXICE TSV.

As per the public notice issued Oct. 19, the number of companies objecting to the plan is 16, demonstrating growing opposition to the tokenization trend.

What Microsoft, Alphabet, and McDonald's are opposing

The companies' protest centres on OKXICE issuing the tokenized version of their stocks.

In simple words, tokenization is the process of using blockchain technology to turn real‑world assets like stocks, real estate, U.S. Treasury bills, etc. into digital tokens which can be traded fractionally, 24/7.

Crypto companies such as Coinbase Global (Nasdaq: COIN), Robinhood Markets (Nasdaq: HOOD), and OKXICE are at the forefront of the tokenization trend.

The tokenized stocks are advantageous to traders who want to buy and sell shares 24/7. They also offer exposure to those from outside the U.S. who don't have access to avenues like the Nasdaq and the NYSE.

But they don't offer shareholder rights such as ownership and voting like original stocks do.

Popular on TheStreet Roundtable:

JPMorgan's answer to the stablecoin threat is here

Major gold holder backs NVIDIA challenger

BlackRock's iconic fund posts strongest day in over 12 months

OKXICE TSV is a proposed tokenized stock trading platform created by OKXICE, a 50-50 joint venture between the NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange and crypto exchange OKX.

The avenue will operate under the innovation exemption published last month by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The exemption lets such platforms offer tokenized versions of the U.S. stocks without registering as exchanges.

The latest notice doesn't explain the companies' reasons or if their objection stops TSV from issuing the tokens. However, it says these tokens could be issued by an outside party or the issuer itself, which could give companies a more direct role in the process.
